name: halo-search
title: Halo Search
blurb: Search input with rotating aurora-like halos and gradient rings around the…
description: A decorative search input surrounded by animated conic-gradient halos that rotate continuously on the button and accelerate with additional rotations on hover and focus-within, using blur filters for an aurora effect.
use_when: Creating premium, visually distinctive interfaces where the search field should be a focal design statement.
avoid_when: When motion accessibility is critical; these CSS animations are continuous and computationally expensive.
a11y: Input is semantic HTML but the halo animations do not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
